items.description: Multi-Variable Panel Econometrics: Macro Labor Dynamics & Well-being

items.name: dynamic-short-panel-replication
items.description: Replication code and data for a dynamic short-panel econometrics study

items.name: Logit-and-Dynamic-Panel-Models
items.description: In this work group, of the discipline "Econometric II", we analyze the impacts of COVID-19 in the brazilian job market. The microdata was obtained from PNAD. We estimate logit, and dynamic panel models to evalute a serie of economic and social variables of the brazilian job market.

items.name: DPTR_bootstrap
items.description: Replication files for "Bootstraps for Dynamic Panel Threshold Models ", Journal of Econometrics (2025)

items.name: DynamicPanelModels.jl
items.description: Dynamic panel GMM estimation in Julia - Arellano-Bond, Blundell-Bond, Anderson-Hsiao, with robust/Windmeijer SEs and diagnostics

items.name: AdvancedEconometrics_Simulation
items.description: Advanced Econometrics : Simulation of Indirect Inference applied to dynamic panel model, Gourieroux et al.(2010)

items.name: econometrics
items.description: An econometric analysis repository utilizing Infosys (INFY) and NIFTY 50 stock market data from 2025–2026. This project applies foundational and advanced time-series and panel data econometrics to model financial returns, test market efficiencies, and analyze dynamic relationships.

items.name: dynamic-panel-monte-carlo
items.description: This repository hosts an econometric simulation framework designed to analyze, visualize, and benchmark the finite-sample performance of estimators in dynamic panel data models. Using a Monte Carlo simulations to quantify the mathematical breakdown of standard estimators under Nickell Bias (O(1/T)) presence in autoregressive AR(1) environments.

items.name: Framework-for-CO-Emission-Decomposition-and-Decarbonization-Dynamics-in-ASEAN
items.description: A Hybrid Machine Learning and Panel Econometric Framework for CO₂ Emission Decomposition and Decarbonization Dynamics in ASEAN

items.name: InfrastructureSupportingScripts
items.description: Empirical analysis of regime-dependent interest-rate sensitivity in UK-listed infrastructure funds using dynamic asset pricing, panel econometrics, and machine learning.

items.name: Global-Environmental-Dynamics-EKC-Analysis
items.description: An econometric study of population aging impacts on CO2 emissions using the Environmental Kuznets Curve (EKC) framework. Implemented in Python with Panel Data analysis.

items.name: railways-industrial-growth-italy
items.description: Econometric analysis on the impact of railways and spatial spillovers on Italian regional manufacturing (1861-1913) using AMG dynamic panel estimation.

items.name: UrbanLandUseEfficiency_DevEconResearchProj
items.description: Urban land-use efficiency analysis using GIS, Google Earth Engine, GHSL spatial data, and dynamic-panel GMM. Introduces the stable BpCR metric.

items.name: dynapanel
items.description: Experimental Python implementation of Difference/System GMM for dynamic panel data. Inspired by Stata's xtabond2.

items.name: A-Firm-Level-Analysis-of-Macroeconomic-Dynamics-Across-Key-Sectors-in-the-SnP500
items.description: An empirical econometrics project evaluating the impact of general and industry-specific inflation on firm-level real stock returns within the S&P 500 (2014–2024). Features a panel data regression model built in STATA analyzing the interplay between asset returns, liquidity, and real economic activity across key market sectors

items.name: wageshift-canada
items.description: Panel-data analysis of provincial minimum-wage changes and youth employment in Canada using R, fixed effects, dynamic models, and robustness checks.

items.name: Countries-in-Conflict-and-Economic-Performance
items.description: By using dynamic panel models, I provide a macro-level understanding of the relationships between a country in conflict, not in conflict, and whether this affects the economic performance in the short and long-term.

items.name: governments_reaction_public_debt_accumulation
items.description: End-to-end Python implementation, based on Canofari et al. (2025), of sovereign fiscal reaction function estimation using Dynamic Common Correlated Effects Mean Group (DCCEMG) methods. Designed for analyzing government debt sustainability across 52 countries with advanced panel econometrics.

items.name: Infrastructure_and_Economic_Growth_in_India
items.description: Built a panel dataset of 350+ observations (2012–2023) and applied Fixed Effects, interaction, and dynamic lag models with clustered SEs to analyze infrastructure–growth dynamics across Indian states. Constructed standardized composite indices (physical, industrial, fiscal).

items.name: xtbreak
items.description: R package for testing and estimating structural breaks in time series and panel data using Bai-Perron and dynamic programming methods. Provides hypothesis tests (supF, UDmax, WDmax), break-date estimation, and support for fixed effects and common correlated effects models.
